result:
**Round 505 is a STOP: it needs B's ruling on A-R505-CR-1 before C runs.** The code change itself applied cleanly and every check matched B's expected numbers.

**What I did:**
- The frozen-file checks 1–3 passed (rc 0), and the patch matched B's recorded sha `5c0ed195…`.
- I applied B's patch exactly as written: 9 files (the chat buttons, the IconButton brand style, two token tests, the new 2d test file, DESIGN_SYSTEM.md and doc 326). After applying, checks 1, 2 and 4 passed (rc 0), and they still pass after the review. Nothing else changed.
- Every number matched B's expected value:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| typecheck | rc 0 |
| lint | rc 0, "Found 179 warnings." |
| biome, 7 files | rc 0, "Checked 7 files", no fixes |
| covering tests | 6 files, 80/80 passed; all 10 new tests (B2D-0…9) ran |

- **Slow test:** UT2 took 1,411 ms here, but 3,186 ms in the last gate run, which is 64% of the 5 s timeout. B already ruled it exempt (B-R505-UT2-TIMEOUT-HEADROOM); it is listed at the top of the report as the lessons require.

**Why it stopped:** the code-reviewer ran, scored the change 8.5/10 and found no Critical or High issues. It did raise one Medium issue, A-R505-CR-1. Test B2D-7 never puts focus on "Start Chat" before the guest form closes, so it doesn't test the real flow. The fix is one line in the new test file, but that goes beyond what B's patch allows. Under the task's rules that is a STOP, so I did not edit the test or downgrade the finding myself.
- B's own earlier browser probe already shows the real flow working: after "Start Chat", focus lands on the message field at all three screen sizes, where HEAD left it on the page body. So the gap is in the jsdom test only, and C's C7 row will check the real path.
- B has two options:
  - **(a)** Rule it Low and let C proceed on this tree.
  - **(b)** Allow the one-line test edit and issue a new post-patch sha for that file.

**For B (Lows, not STOPs):**
- **CR-2:** focus is lost when a session ends and a new one starts while the window stays open. This is a different path from the already-ruled sign-in/sign-out case.
- **CR-3:** the send logic is duplicated between the button and the Enter key, so the two could drift apart.
- **CR-4:** the focus guard ignores a `null` active element. If that happens, the field just isn't focused, which is safe.
- **Architecture note:** keep the current structure. If the deferred "Live Chat open focus" task lands, move all chat focus decisions into `ChatWindow`.
- **Stale primitive:** `DESIGN_TOKENS.md` still lists the brand colour as teal.

I did not run the full test suite, the build or any browser check. I mark no browser acceptance row (C1–C12) as passed, and the round is not complete.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `a-round-505.md`
- `a-round-505/code-review.md` (the reviewer's full output)
- the logs in `a-round-505/`
